cohort: 196 pregnant women with IHCP, divided into early IHCP (diagnosed <= 32 weeks, n=40) and late IHCP (diagnosed > 32 weeks, n=156), and further subdivided into four groups based on SBA levels (10-19, 20-29, 30-39, and >=40 mmol/L).
finding: Women diagnosed with early IHCP and those with higher SBA levels (>=30 mmol/L) experienced more adverse maternal and fetal outcomes.
birth_weight: low birth weight (mentioned as an outcome but no specific ranges provided)
